headline: 45 changes affect CPSC-watched codes
overview: Of 333 changes in 2026HTSRev11, 45 touch CPSC-watched codes, 51 need a decision and 7 are worth checking. 11 watched codes were removed, split or renumbered, so CPSC targeting may need updating. 3 changes are Chapter 99 tariff provisions, which do not affect product coverage.

top_changes.summary: Code 3926.90.99.10 (Other: Laboratory ware) was removed, and new codes 3926.90.99.15 and 3926.90.99.20 appeared in the same group; they may replace it, so a person should check.
Code 7113.19.29.00 (Necklaces and neck chains, of gold: Other) was renumbered to 7113.19.29.90.
Code 8307.10.60.00 (Of iron or steel: Other) was renumbered to 8307.10.60.60.
Code 8424.30.90.00 (Steam or sand blasting machines and similar jet projecting machines: Other) was renumbered to 8424.30.90.90.

Code 8424.90.90.40 (Other: Of steam and similar jet projecting machines) was removed, and new codes 8424.90.90.10 and 8424.90.90.20 appeared in the same group; they may replace it, so a person should check.

Code 8504.40.95.70 (Other: Inverters) was removed, and new codes 8504.40.95.71, 8504.40.95.73, 8504.40.95.75, 8504.40.95.77, 8504.40.95.78 and 8504.40.95.79 appeared in the same group; they may replace it, so a person should check.
Code 8507.20.80.10 (Other: Of a kind described in subheading 9903.45.25) was removed, and new codes 8507.20.80.92 appeared in the same group; they may replace it, so a person should check.
